investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Northpine Credit Union; Platform: on-premises data center, server range 10.8.0.0/16; Database: PostgreSQL 14 (pg-primary-01 plus streaming replicas) on rack servers with hardware RAID-10 controllers; reporting-api and statements-batch read from replicas through pgbouncer; Change management: CHG- (software/configuration) and DC- (data-center hands-on work) identifiers.
